summary: Small but important Web Audio fixes: a typo in SSE4.2 configuration handling was corrected (SSE4.2 is a CPU SIMD feature used to speed up audio processing), and the code now properly handles promise rejections from repeated OfflineAudioContext.startRendering() calls used for offline/fast audio rendering. These changes improve stability and ensure the browser uses the right CPU-optimised paths safely during automated fuzz/crash tests.
